description.value: A family-owned whitewater rafting operation on the Clearwater River in Wells Gray Provincial Park, running for over 30 years. They offer owner-guided trips ranging from scenic float tours to multi-day rafting expeditions on the Babine and Nass rivers. All gear is provided including wetsuits, helmets, and life jackets, so touring cyclists could join a trip without carrying any extra equipment.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website confirms Riverside Adventures is an active whitewater rafting company in Clearwater, BC near Wells Gray Provincial Park, operating for over 30 years. Phone (250-318-5223), email, and address (42 Young Road, Clearwater) come from the website; OSM has none of these fields populated. The FAQ page mentions a 'change room and locker' for guests to change into wetsuits and store personal belongings, which confirms locker/storage availability for customers. No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, food service, or any cycling-specific amenities anywhere on the site.
